title: Locked Rate Pricing Clause — Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
**Clause.** The locked rate of a Builder Extended Rate Lock is the par rate on the lock plus the term premium, plus the term's extra rate premium on a jumbo loan, less the term's government program premium reduction on fha, va or usda, never below the par rate, rounded half up to three decimal places. The term premium is the rate premium of the lock's term.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Par rate and loan program | the lock record |
| Rate premium, jumbo extra premium, government program reduction | the product's rate sheet premiums for the lock's term |

## Formation

| Loan program on the lock | Locked rate before the floor and rounding |
|---|---|
| jumbo | par rate plus term premium plus the jumbo extra premium |
| fha, va or usda | par rate plus term premium less the government program reduction |
| conventional | par rate plus term premium |

The result is then held at no less than the par rate and rounded half up to three decimal places.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs: par rate 6.250, term premium 0.375, jumbo extra premium 0.250, government program reduction 0.125)

| Loan program | Locked rate |
|---|---|
| conventional | 6.250 plus 0.375 gives 6.625 |
| jumbo | 6.250 plus 0.375 plus 0.250 gives 6.875 |
| va | 6.250 plus 0.375 less 0.125 gives 6.500 |

Floor, hypothetical: par rate 6.250, term premium 0.000 and a government program reduction of 0.125 would give 6.125, which is below the par rate; the locked rate is 6.250.
